title: Integral open and closed pieces remain constructible and rationalize to the localization sequence
statement:
Let $\ell$ be prime, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite, $A=\mathcal O_E$ and $\varpi$ a uniformizer [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $X$ be a noetherian finite-dimensional scheme on which $\ell$ is invertible [def-pc-scheme]; noetherian means a finite affine cover by spectra of noetherian rings, and finite-dimensional means a finite bound on lengths of strict chains of irreducible closed subsets. Write $A_Y(V)=C(|V|,A)$ and $E_Y(V)=C(|V|,E)$ on the small pro-etale site of any locally closed subscheme $Y$ of $X$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Use sheaf modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and $S_Y(M)=E_Y\otimes_{A_Y}M$ [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Constructible integral means continuous-constructible as in [def-weil-pbc-continuous-constructible-module], with local models $A_Y\otimes_A P$ for finitely presented $A$-modules $P$ on finitely many locally closed strata. Let $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ be a closed immersion and $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ its complementary open immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion, def-weil-open-immersion]. Use the module inverse images, direct image and extension by zero of [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-ringed-open-closed], with coefficient rings on the subschemes identified by [lem-weil-pbc-continuous-coefficients-immersion-restriction]. If $M_U$ and $M_Z$ are constructible integral sheaves on $U$ and $Z$, then $Q=j_!M_U$ and $P=i_*M_Z$ are constructible integral sheaves on $X$, and
$$S_XQ\cong j_!S_UM_U,\qquad S_XP\cong i_*S_ZM_Z.$$
If $L$ is any $E_X$-module sheaf with specified isomorphisms $S_UM_U\cong j^{-1}L$ and $S_ZM_Z\cong i^{-1}L$ [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image], these comparisons identify the canonical open-closed sequence with a short exact sequence
$$0\longrightarrow S_XQ\longrightarrow L\longrightarrow S_XP\longrightarrow0$$
[def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence].

source.place: Lemma 6.8.13, constructible filtration and extension assembly; Stacks Tags 09AH (proetale.tex, lemma-ses-associated-to-open), 09AA (lemma-closed-immersion), 09BN (lemma-open-immersion) and 03DI (sites-modules.tex, lemma-extension-by-zero).
